production_readiness.current_rule: Measure the exact unique chunks reachable from authenticated retained manifests, then add only manifest, pointer, deployment-seal, and observational-receipt bytes.
production_readiness.zero_learning_rule: The full-engine generation writer must produce zero changed learned files and zero new learned-content chunk bytes. Only named manifest and receipt paths may change.
production_readiness.causal_mutation_rule: Every changed learned file and every newly retained learned-content chunk must be covered exactly by an HMAC-authenticated generation mutation receipt bound to the engine's opaque causal authority receipt SHA-256.

content_delta_producer.proved_cleanup: A rejected uncovered mutation retains no candidate generation or unreachable content chunk locally and writes no S3 object because validation precedes upload.

producer_bounds.cold_generations: CURRENT plus one verified predecessor; one unpublished candidate exists only inside the atomic transaction.
producer_bounds.cold_content: Content-addressed shared chunks are retained by exact manifest reachability; generation directories contain manifests only.
producer_bounds.live_recovery: Three retained overlays and one transaction candidate use shared content-addressed chunks; unchanged teaching state is stored once.

ring.body_policy: event detail is represented only by its SHA-256 and byte count

diary.body_policy: observational detail is not copied into the durable diary

producer_bounds.orphan_cleanup: Failed transactions discard unpublished candidates immediately; sealed boot removes verified candidates newer than authenticated CURRENT and reconciles unreachable chunks.

legacy_active_state_cutover.required_result: Place the exact legacy organism, deep-atlas, and old word/chi/scripted-meaning bytes in temporary authenticated migration escrow only. Active startup must neither inflate nor consult them. After the new active state passes exact cold restore and live cutover proof, hard-delete every escrow object version and delete marker and verify absence.

active_graph_classification.preserve: Lawful neuron physical and dynamic state plus the new explicit auditory field and causal THING state.
active_graph_classification.retire: Old word/chi binding accumulation, scripted meaning authorities, legacy wave snapshots, and deep-atlas meaning payloads.

legacy_active_state_cutover.escrow_retirement_gate: The migrated active generation must pass exact identity, tick, lawful 106-neuron physical/dynamic-state, auditory-state, and causal-THING cold restore; the deployed task must then pass live cutover verification before version-aware hard purge of all escrow bytes.

structural_graph_exact_production_proof.diagnosis: Most graph volume is legacy wave and chi binding accumulation rather than the lawful 106-neuron physical state.
structural_graph_exact_production_proof.active_authority: Only lawful neuron physical/dynamic state plus explicit causal THING and auditory field state remain active. Old word/chi/scripted meaning is retired, and its temporary migration escrow is hard-purged after the exact restore and live cutover gate.

deployed_runtime_transition.legacy_ring_status: The currently deployed process wrote old full-detail telemetry. Retire it only after the new receipt-only writer is deployed and authenticated.
deployed_runtime_transition.required_action: Restart the task as part of deployment to reclaim the old process heap, then verify receipt-only ring and content-addressed live recovery before retiring the legacy event log.
deployed_runtime_transition.new_code_status: LiveRecoveryGenerationStore requires content_addressed=True and the unchanged 7 MiB teaching-body proof stores its chunks once.

hard_global_refusal_ceiling.candidate_startup_contract: missing, noninteger, or nonpositive configuration halts readiness; a different value from the durable scope receipt is rejected by the shared physical-byte authority.

emergency_infrastructure_refusal_envelop.reason_retained: This derived protocol census remains diagnostic only. The separately approved 5368709120-byte hard global ceiling is the candidate write authority. These values must not be used to justify normal retained storage.

failure_contract.uncovered_learned_mutation: refuse before remote upload and remove the unpublished local candidate plus unreachable chunks
failure_contract.atomic_replacement_failure: restore prior bytes and remove temporary candidate
failure_contract.learned_state_deletion: forbidden; capacity refusal never deletes reachable learned state
failure_contract.remote_retirement: retain exactly objects reachable from authenticated generation manifests and hard-delete every unreachable version and delete marker
